description: Defines helper functions and factories for constructing dmrs_information objects used in 5G NR scheduling, specifically for PDSCH and PUSCH DMRS configurations, including calculation of REs, and handling different mapping types and configurations.

methods.name: calculate_nof_dmrs_per_rb
methods.description: Calculates the number of RE used for DMRS per RB in PDSCH and PUSCH transmissions based on DMRS configuration.

methods.name: make_dmrs_info_common
methods.description: Creates a default dmrs_information object for DCI f1_0 or when higher layer parameters are unavailable, based on PDSCH or PUSCH resource allocations.

methods.name: make_dmrs_info_dedicated
methods.description: Creates a dmrs_information object for dedicated DMRS configuration, considering additional positions, antenna ports, and configuration type.
